description: Store L402 payment credentials (macaroon + preimage) after paying a routing invoice. Call this after the user has paid the Lightning invoice returned by a payment_required response. Once stored, all subsequent routing calls (score-venues, get-isochrone, get-directions) will authenticate automatically.

macaroon.description: The macaroon from the payment_required response

preimage.description: The payment preimage obtained after paying the invoice

name: store-routing-credentials
